description:
## Current delivery contract — user-approved two-outcome stack
Owner: PR A. One PR per complete outcome, NOT one PR per bead. Keep detailed beads and cohesive internal commits for tracking; consolidate existing draft foundations into their owning feature PR where practical. PR B stacks on independently usable PR A. Include owning PR documentation and validation there. This supersedes earlier per-bead/prerequisite PR instructions and historical comments. Closed foundation status is not outcome acceptance.
New-feature E2E requires explicit human UX approval in zaq-emb.12; no self-approval.

Inbound IMAP parser/evidence slice after .14.2.1. Normalize sender plus all visible To/Cc addresses from the current message; hidden Bcc only when receiving account identity is independently established from connector configuration (not IMAP folder, Delivered-To alone, thread participants or guessed mailbox). Stamp typed channel-only per-message evidence for later Engine Person resolution, never credentials or an access grant. Fail closed on ambiguous account evidence. Tests FIRST with RFC822 and adapter fixtures for sender copy, evolving recipients, hidden Bcc denial/confirmation, malformed addresses and property dedup. Preserve existing threading/reply_from behavior. No new Action/tool, credential changes or feature E2E. Outbound SMTP sender/envelope receipt is separately owned by .14.2.4; read Channels guide and Action reuse.

comments.text: 2026-09-26 pre-implementation discovery: ImapAdapter.Parser currently chooses one Mail.get_to/first raw To recipient and records Delivered-To as reply_from; it does not normalize all To/Cc or Bcc. IMAP selected mailbox is folder name; NotificationImapLive settings persist username and selected_mailboxes but no separately verified receiving-account email identity. Even when username looks like an address or Delivered-To is present, do NOT infer hidden Bcc; normalize visible To/Cc and sender only, accepting Bcc evidence only from future independently verified connector account identity. SMTP outbound actual sender and explicit envelope recipient receipt belongs .14.2.4. Actor Person resolution happens after Channels in IncomingMessageRouter; this slice carries address evidence only, not authorized Person IDs. Tests first from parsed RFC822 fixtures; no feature E2E before UX gate.

Action reuse assessment: normalize per-message inbound RFC822 recipient evidence. Existing Mail.parse/Mail.get_to/Mail.get_cc and EmailBridge.ImapAdapter.Parser.to_incoming/3 already parse inbound messages; this extends that local parser boundary. Registry/agent tools and workflow Actions have no appropriate standalone channel-envelope normalization operation; adding or exposing one would duplicate transport parsing and permit arbitrary caller-controlled audience. Inputs: raw IMAP payload + parsed RFC headers; outputs: validated sender and visible To/Cc addresses on typed routing context (not Person IDs/grants); errors: malformed addresses excluded, invalid payload existing error; idempotent/pure, no runtime dependencies beyond Mail. Consumers: EmailBridge ingress now, Engine Person resolution in zaq-emb.4 later; not a tool/workflow. Tests: RFC822 multi-To/Cc, fallback payload, malformed/duplicate, hidden Bcc excluded, per-message isolation and retained reply_from/threading. No credential/settings operation in this slice.

title: [zaq-emb.14.2.2] Normalize inbound email recipient evidence
